ruling: Coordinator 2026-09-25: champion money includes the industry PACs' contributions. Channels: (1) employee direct giving (v2), (2) company-PAC giving, (3) trade-association PAC giving (separate). Primary DV = 1 + 2; sensitivity = 1 + 2 + 3. Independent expenditures (24A/24E) are not contributions: excluded from the DV; 24E kept as a descriptive column.

pac_source_path.used: raw FEC pas2 (itpas2.txt 2022/2024/2026 from the active FEC inputs .cache\repair-20260908-inputs, sha256 equal to source-manifest.json), streamed into a derived SQLite, D-049 applied in Python (build\champions_v3\d049.py) as Mentat's R pas2 parser does under count_latest (the policy D-049 applied: transfer index VERSION 4 / PAS2 parser 5)
pac_source_path.why_not_transfer_index: Mentat's fec_transfer_graph.py index (files transfer-index-v4c-* and transfer-edges.csv under fec_beneficiary\oth22/24/26; VERSION 4, count_latest) is built from the oth file and keeps only 24G/24K cash transfers between committees: it has no CAND_ID and no 24Z (in-kind) or 24E (IE support) rows, so it cannot deliver the brief's CAND_ID matching, 24Z or the 24E column. The live code is now VERSION 5 (count_all); no v5 index exists, so its current reader would treat the v4 files as stale. Its published v4 edges were used as a cross-check of the 24K dollars (probe transfer_index_v4_crosscheck).
pac_source_path.d049_on_these_rows: Among the 38 candidate committees' 27563 pas2 rows, D-049 statuses: {'included': 27461, 'memo_only': 99, 'included_no_candidate_id': 3}. Rows with no CAND_ID stay countable only through a recipient-committee match (champion-matched: [('C00804179', 'C00896019', 2026, 2500.0)]).
pac_source_path.refunds: Netted by signed summation: negative 24K/24Z rows in the PAC's own pas2 filings (refunds/voids) are included rows and reduce the channel in the cycle filed. Refunds reported only by the recipient committee (oth 22Z) are not netted (probe recipient_reported_refunds_22Z).
pac_source_path.matching: A pas2 row is the champion's when its CAND_ID is one of the champion's FEC IDs or its recipient committee (OTHER_ID) is in the champion's committee_sets. Counted: recipient = an authorized committee that cycle (authorized), an authorized committee of another cycle with the champion's CAND_ID (authorized_other_cycle), or the champion's authorized committee with a CAND_ID absent from the YAML that the FEC candidate masters do not assign to another person (authorized_candidate_id_variant: Hinson S6IA00314, Donalds H0FL19205, Miller-Meeks H0IA02180, Flood H2NE01167, Ricketts S4NE00173/S6NE00173). Not counted: leadership / J-U committees, other committees. 24E by CAND_ID only.

pac_sets.rule: Per industry, the union of the three cycles' PAC & Candidate Map rows (Recipient Category Company PAC -> company; Trade Association -> classified), plus Banking roster companies' connected PACs from verified_company_affiliations.json, plus the industry's own association from trade_committee_overrides.csv when its map lacks it (ICBA for community banks). pac_sets repeats the set per cycle with in_map_this_cycle.
